question: Which eminent Indian astrophysicist and science communicator, known for founding IUCAA and receiving both Padma Bhushan and Padma Vibhushan, recently passed away at age 87?
solution:
The Correct Answer is ​__**Dr. Jayant Vishnu Narlikar**__.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/7a63139f3b57ffe3814d27f8dcaee8cb420142f7146b480d479d526074519671.png] **__In News__**

__
 
• Padma Vibhushan Astrophysicist Jayant Narlikar Dies At 87.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **Key Points__**

 
• 
 
**Dr. Jayant Vishnu Narlikar**, renowned Indian astrophysicist and science communicator, passed away at **87** in **Pune**.

 
 
• 
 
He was the **Founder Director** of **IUCAA**, established in **1988** with the help of the **UGC**.

 
 
• 
 
He served as IUCAA’s Director until **2003**.

 
 
• 
 
He was awarded the **Padma Bhushan** in **1965** at the age of **26**.

 
 
• 
 
He received the **Padma Vibhushan** in **2004** and **Maharashtra Bhushan** in **2011**.

 
 
• 
 
**UNESCO** honoured him with the **Kalinga Award** in **1996** for science communication.

 
 
• 
 
In **2012**, **TWAS** (Third World Academy of Sciences) awarded him for establishing a centre of scientific excellence.

 
 
• 
 
His **Marathi autobiography** won the **Sahitya Akademi Award** in **2014**.
